en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a half‑timbered German tavern or inn on a sloped cobblestone street. The building has a steep tiled roof, shuttered windows, and painted shields on the facade. A large sign identifies it as a beer and wine tavern, and three women in aprons and dresses stand in the doorway while a man poses on the steps. Another man is visible along the street. The lower edge of the image shows damage typical of old photographic postcards.
